admin-pass.add.description: Button that adds an empty row to the welcome schedule editor.

admin-pass.column.at.description: Column heading: the date and time from which a row's phase shows on the pass.

admin-pass.column.phase.description: Column heading: which welcome text the pass shows.

admin-pass.current.description: The phase the schedule sets right now. {phase} is one of the phase names, such as Chegada.

admin-pass.customLabel.description: A custom phase where a phase name is shown, as in the current phase or the next switch. {text} is the line the administrator wrote. Personalizado is the custom phase's name and must match it.

admin-pass.defaults.empty.defaultMessage: Empty: attendee tickets show the default line for the whole event.
admin-pass.defaults.empty.description: Shown when the server configuration sets no welcome schedule. Chegada is the arrival phase's name and must match it.

admin-pass.defaults.heading.defaultMessage: Default set in the server configuration
admin-pass.defaults.heading.description: Heading of the read-only list of the schedule in the server configuration. `.env` is the file's name and stays as is.

admin-pass.defaults.hint.defaultMessage: Applies while no schedule is saved here. Changing it requires access to the server.
admin-pass.defaults.hint.description: Under the .env schedule's heading: it is the fallback, and only someone with access to the host can change it.

admin-pass.editor.empty.defaultMessage: No changes: attendee tickets show the default line for the whole event.
admin-pass.editor.empty.description: Shown in the editor when it has no rows. Saving an empty schedule is allowed and means the arrival text for the whole event. Chegada is the arrival phase's name.

admin-pass.editor.fromDefaults.defaultMessage: The editor follows the server configuration. Once you save, your schedule takes over.
admin-pass.editor.fromDefaults.description: Shown above the editor while no schedule is saved here: the rows are a copy of the server configuration's, and saving makes them take over. `.env` stays as is.

admin-pass.editor.heading.description: Heading of the welcome schedule editor.

admin-pass.editor.hint.defaultMessage: Times are in the event time zone ({timeZone}). Row order does not matter: the lines will be reordered after you save.
admin-pass.editor.hint.description: Under the editor's heading. {timeZone} is an IANA time zone name such as America/Sao_Paulo, kept as is.

admin-pass.failed.description: Error when saving the welcome schedule fails for any reason not otherwise named.

admin-pass.forbidden.defaultMessage: Your account cannot change the schedule of the lines shown on the ticket.
admin-pass.forbidden.description: Error when an administrator without the pass:write permission tries to save the welcome schedule.

admin-pass.heading.description: Heading of the screen that schedules the welcome line on the attendee's pass.

admin-pass.intro.defaultMessage: The line below the name on the attendee ticket changes over the course of the event. Set here when each line appears: attendee tickets update automatically within 30 seconds.

admin-pass.invalid.duplicateTime.defaultMessage: Two rows have the same time. Each line must be scheduled for a different time.
admin-pass.invalid.duplicateTime.description: Shown before sending when two rows in the editor have the same date and time.

admin-pass.invalid.missingText.defaultMessage: The text field cannot be empty.
admin-pass.invalid.missingText.description: Shown before sending when a custom row in the editor has no text.

admin-pass.invalid.missingTime.defaultMessage: Fill in the date and time on every row.
admin-pass.invalid.missingTime.description: Shown before sending when a row in the editor has no date and time.

admin-pass.legend.custom.defaultMessage: The text typed on the row itself, exactly as written.
admin-pass.legend.custom.description: In the list of what each phase shows, the entry for the custom phase: its text is the one typed on its row, not a fixed one.

admin-pass.legend.heading.description: Heading of the list pairing each phase name with the text it puts on the pass.

admin-pass.legend.note.defaultMessage: Before the first switch, the ticket shows the default line. While the scheduled line is the feedback survey one, anyone who has already answered sees a thank-you, and anyone whose survey is not open sees the default line. A custom line appears for everyone.
admin-pass.legend.note.description: Explains the rules the schedule does not control. Chegada, Questionário, Agradecimento, Padrão and Personalizado are the phase names and must match them.

admin-pass.next.description: The schedule's next switch. {phase} is a phase name; {at} is a date and time in the event's time zone.

admin-pass.next.none.defaultMessage: No lines scheduled from here on.
admin-pass.next.none.description: Shown when the schedule in force has no switch after now.

admin-pass.phase.arrival.description: Name of the arrival phase: the welcome shown as people arrive, and before the first scheduled switch.

admin-pass.phase.custom.description: Name of the custom phase: a line the administrator writes on the schedule row itself, shown on the pass exactly as written.

admin-pass.phase.default.description: Name of the default phase: the general welcome during the event.

admin-pass.phase.survey.description: Name of the survey phase: the line pointing to the questionnaire.

admin-pass.phase.thanks.description: Name of the thanks phase: the closing line once feedback is in.

admin-pass.preview.description: The text a phase puts on the pass, quoted. {text} is that text.

admin-pass.remove.description: Accessible name of the button that removes one row from the editor. Read by screen readers; the button shows only an icon.

admin-pass.reset.description: Button that discards the schedule saved here so passes follow the server configuration again. `.env` stays as is.

admin-pass.reset.confirm.description: The reset button's label once pressed, asking for a second press to discard the saved schedule. It reverts to the reset label after a few seconds. `.env` stays as is.

admin-pass.reset.done.defaultMessage: Tickets are following the server configuration again
admin-pass.reset.done.description: Toast on the reloaded screen once the saved schedule is discarded. `.env` stays as is.

admin-pass.save.description: Button that saves the welcome schedule.

admin-pass.saved.description: Toast on the reloaded screen once the welcome schedule is saved.

admin-pass.source.admin.description: Which schedule the passes follow: the one saved on this screen.

admin-pass.source.env.description: Which schedule the passes follow: the server configuration's. `.env` stays as is.

admin-pass.text.description: Accessible name and placeholder of the text box on a custom row: the line the pass shows from that row's time.
